467:t_10:14.en:
$$ジャンゴ$$

467:t_10:23.en:

468:t_001:4.en:

468:t_001:6.en:

468:t_001:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It's quite simple. Your father, Dr. $$兜剣造$$, is under my protection too.」

468:t_001:9.en:

468:t_001:10.en:

468:t_001:11.en:

468:t_001:12.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I have no intention of answering any more of your questions.」

468:t_001:13.en:
$$甲児$$

468:t_001:14.en:
$$甲児$$

468:t_001:15.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「All trials are for the sake of the future.」

468:t_001:17.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$

468:t_001:19.en:

468:t_002:8.en:
